title: Jacen Syndulla
subtitle: Rebel
description: As the son of the Twi'lek Rebellion leader Hera Syndulla and Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus, Jacen Syndulla was a special kid. He was a blend of both of his parents and spent time on the Ghost, showing himself gifted in the ways of the Force. Once, on the planet Seatos, looking for Ahsoka Tano, Jacen was able to hone in on her presence using the Force and enable Hera to rescue the fallen, former Jedi.
